gulangyu.name: Gulangyu Island
gulangyu.price_text: ≈ CNY 35–100 ferry round trip; island entry free, some gardens and museums charge extra
gulangyu.hours: Ferries roughly 07:00–18:00 from Xiamen; check last boat on the day
gulangyu.tip: Book the ferry online in advance with your passport and go early; the island is car-free, so wear comfortable shoes.
gulangyu.best: Weekday morning; avoid Chinese public holidays

nanputuo.name: Nanputuo Temple
nanputuo.price_text: Free entry; small fee for some halls may apply
nanputuo.tip: Climb the steps behind the temple for a view over Xiamen University and the sea.

kinmen.name: Kinmen Islands (view from Xiamen)
kinmen.price_text: Viewing is free; crossing to Kinmen needs separate permits and is not a simple day trip
kinmen.tip: Treat Kinmen as a distant view from the coast, not a casual excursion; check current entry rules before planning anything.

luckin.name: Luckin Coffee (city branches)
luckin.price_text: ≈ CNY 15–30 per drink, order in the app
luckin.tip: Order and pay in the Luckin app; many small branches have no seats, so take it away.

xiamen-island.name: Xiamen Island (city base)
xiamen-island.price_text: Free to explore; pay per transport and attraction
xiamen-island.tip: Use the bus and metro to move between the old town, the lake and the beaches; taxis are cheap but slow at rush hour.
xiamen-island.best: Any time; spring and autumn are mildest

zhongshan-road.name: Zhongshan Road pedestrian street
zhongshan-road.tip: Come in the evening for the lights, and duck into the side lanes for cheaper local snacks.

eight-market.name: Eighth Market food lanes
eight-market.tip: Point at what looks busy and freshly cooked; bring small cash and tissues.

yundang-lake.name: Yundang Lake walk
yundang-lake.tip: Walk the loop at dusk when locals come out to jog and fish.

cafe-street.name: Xiamen coffee street (Yundang Lake area)
cafe-street.tip: Xiamen has a strong cafe culture; pick a spot with outdoor seats and watch the lake.

xmu-campus.name: Xiamen University campus walk
xmu-campus.price_text: Free, but visitor entry needs advance booking and a passport
xmu-campus.hours: Visitor slots vary; check on the day
xmu-campus.tip: Book a visitor slot online before you go; entry is limited and often full at weekends.

baicheng-beach.name: Baicheng Beach
baicheng-beach.tip: Good sunset spot facing Gulangyu; the sand is coarse and currents can be strong.

huandao-road.name: Huandao Road coastal ride
huandao-road.price_text: ≈ CNY 20–60 to rent a bike for a few hours
huandao-road.tip: Ride the seaside path south of the university; go early to avoid heat and crowds.

shapowei.name: Shapowei old harbour lanes
shapowei.hours: Lanes open all day; cafes later
shapowei.tip: Small streets of old fishing houses turned cafes; good for photos and a slow afternoon.

seafood-dinner.name: Seafood dinner at a local restaurant
seafood-dinner.tip: Ask the price per weight before ordering shellfish; prices change daily.

ferry-tour.name: Harbour evening boat ride
ferry-tour.tip: Confirm the route and duration at the ticket office; views of the lit-up coast are the draw.

gulangyu-villas.name: Gulangyu old villas and lanes
gulangyu-villas.price_text: Free to walk; some houses charge entry
gulangyu-villas.tip: Skip the main shopping street and wander the quieter lanes to the west for the old colonial houses.

sunlight-rock.name: Sunlight Rock viewpoint
sunlight-rock.tip: Climb early for the island view before tour groups arrive; the steps are steep.

nanputuo-vegetarian.name: Vegetarian meal near Nanputuo
nanputuo-vegetarian.hours: Lunch and early dinner; check on the day
nanputuo-vegetarian.tip: Simple temple-style vegetarian food; go at off-peak hours to avoid queues.

lujiang-night.name: Lujiang waterfront evening walk
lujiang-night.tip: Walk the seafront promenade at night for the skyline and the breeze off the strait.

museum.name: Xiamen Museum
museum.price_text: Free with ID; check current rules
museum.tip: Good rainy-day option covering local history; bring your passport for entry.

zengcuoan.name: Zengcuoan village lanes
zengcuoan.price_text: Free to walk; food and drinks extra
zengcuoan.hours: Lanes open all day; busiest evening
zengcuoan.tip: A former fishing village now full of small cafes and guesthouses; combine it with the nearby beach.

gulangyu-organ.name: Gulangyu organ museum
gulangyu-organ.tip: Small museum of pipe organs tied to the island's musical past; a short indoor break from the sun.

ferry-ticket.name: Gulangyu ferry booking desk
ferry-ticket.price_text: ≈ CNY 35–50 round trip depending on route
ferry-ticket.tip: Book online in advance with your passport; tourist boats leave from the main passenger terminal, not the old town pier.
